assumptions.engines: two real 1.2.0 AutoSwitchEngine instances, one per Mac, each with its own fake switcher, sequence, tiers, lines and state file; usage is account-wide and shared
assumptions.settings: threshold 85 (scale only: every account has its own line), weeklyThreshold unset, intervalSeconds 60, cooldownSeconds 300, hysteresisPct 10, unhealthyTicks 3, no model, API-key accounts excluded; ticks every 60 s 24/7 (jitter pinned), perfect polling
assumptions.personalMac: priority-consume-first; tiers/lines personal2 100/95, work 50/L, work2 50/L, personal 10/80; demand weekdays 19-24 CET, weekends 10-13 & 16-20, all heavy (ceiling); starts on personal2
assumptions.workMac: work + work2 only, lines W on both, tier 50 on both; demand weekdays 08-20 CET uniform within the day; day volume 16 x demand x factor (Mon..Fri) with mean and median factor 1.0; starts on work. Status quo: no engine, stays on work
assumptions.rates: Pro heavy 1.1 5h-%/min, Max 5x 0.22; 7d = 5h/6; work-Mac 5h = 6 x its 7d rate
assumptions.app: personal only, 30 pts 7d/week, 3 x 10-min bursts/day at 08:00 12:30 17:30 CET, 5h at 6x
assumptions.window: warm-up Mon 11-02 00:00 CET with every 7d at 0; metrics over Sun 11-08 00:00 -> Sun 11-22 00:00 CET, which holds two resets of every account, each closing a fully simulated week
assumptions.resets: weekly, CET: work Wed 12:00, personal Fri 08:00, work2 Sat 13:00, personal2 Sat 22:00; 5h window opens at first use and closes 5 h later
assumptions.wall: work Mac: demand minute with its active exhausted (5h or 7d at 100) and no other work account below W on both windows; status quo: any exhausted demand minute. personal Mac: unserved fraction of its demand minutes (D3)
